name: Ganja
author: ZeD
description: A cannabis plant that grows in your bar. The grow from Ganja-TUI - same genetics, same ASCII art, same save - in pure QML, with no binary and no resident process. Closed it costs one 60-second timer; stopped, nothing at all.

barWidget.description: A plant in the bar: one glyph per stage, a dot when there is something to do
